rootCauses.detail: DeepSeek generated catalog cloned gpt-6-sol and retained multi_agent_version=v2, although native MAv2 direct messages require an encrypted_function_args discriminator absent in actual Flash responses.
Direct collaboration spawn/send/followup is Plaintext only when encrypted_function_args is explicitly an empty list. Absence selects Direct.
Direct calls wrap the message as AgentMessage::Encrypted; the plain Flash task was emitted as encrypted_content and not followed by child.
Model catalog multi_agent_version wins over false V2 feature default. Native feature false alone does not select V1.

diagnosticControls.outcome: Test harness preflight error before actual worker: thread/turns/list unavailable for an unmaterialized empty thread; test corrected, not product bug.
Official Flash Responses rejected native CodeMode custom tool exec; path not adopted.
Only V2 feature false retained model catalog V2. Surface token/sum succeeded, but actual native child plaintext assertion failed; not compatible/pass.
Per-thread catalog file override did not replace already initialized ModelsManager; actual native V2 persisted, so not counted V1 or fixed.

fixPlan: Correct generated DeepSeek model catalog to explicit native v1; launch/reconnect app-server to load fixed catalog and validate fresh native V1 parents/children. Keep existing conversation history.
upgradeLimit: A conversation records its protocol version on first activation. Existing V2 histories may retain V2; no supported external migration endpoint was found. Do not rewrite native rollout or silently disable delegation.

remaining: Native V2 remains incompatible with Flash direct message encoding; pre-existing V2 histories do not automatically migrate. New compatible V1 conversation is required for delegation from such old histories. This is not an unresolved fresh-session review/worker timeout.
